verdict.rationale: Channel3 publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at channel3.ai/docs/openapi/openapi.json, with 48 paths and 5 webhooks, and the docs llms.txt advertises it under "OpenAPI Specs". The probe's 404s were on different docs.trychannel3.com paths, so they don't contradict the spec's existence; they only show it isn't at the conventional locations on that domain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the download, and proper spec metadata (the info block still has the framework defaults "FastAPI" / "0.1.0").

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Channel3 publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (48 paths plus 5 webhooks, production server https://api.trychannel3.com), advertised in the docs llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs".
